description: This source file defines a utility function 'shapeStackedSeries' that processes an array of cost records and structures them into a dataset suitable for visualization with stacking, zero-filling missing data. It is part of a frontend codebase, possibly used for data visualization in a costs dashboard.

methods.name: shapeStackedSeries(records, stackBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms an array of cost records into a dataset optimized for stacked bar charts, with options for sorting and labeling.
